name: initialise_record_flag_mode_one
description: Chooses a mode value of one or a flagged alternative from a flag byte, then calls a subroutine on the record's source value. It sets the record's link pointer according to that result, fills the header fields from local values and returns the record.

name: initialise_record_fixed_mode_one
description: Uses a fixed mode value of one, calls a subroutine, and sets the record's link pointer according to its result. It then fills the header fields from local values and returns the record.

name: create_record_with_mode_flags
description: Builds an access mode from a flag byte and fixed bits, then calls a subroutine with it and a fixed permission value. If that call returns an error value it returns a null pointer; otherwise it sets a second mode, links the record, fills its header and returns it.

name: create_record_fixed_access
description: Calls a subroutine with fixed access bits and a fixed permission value, returning a null pointer if it reports failure. Otherwise it sets a mode of two or a flagged alternative, links the record, fills its header and returns it.

name: initialise_record_flag_mode_two
description: Chooses a mode value of two or a flagged alternative from a flag byte, then calls a subroutine. It sets the record's link pointer from the result, fills the header fields from local values and returns the record.

name: initialise_record_fixed_mode_two
description: Uses a fixed mode value of two, calls a subroutine, and sets the record's link pointer from its result. It then fills the header fields and returns the record.

name: initialise_record_without_mode
description: Calls a subroutine, sets the record's link pointer according to its result, fills the header fields from local values and returns the record. No mode value is set.

name: initialise_record_unlinked
description: Clears the record's link pointer without calling any subroutine, fills the header fields from local values and returns the record.

name: clear_object_links
description: Clears the links held in an object structure. It calls subroutines on the stored values when flag bits allow, then zeroes the pointer fields and the flag byte, and finally passes one byte field to another subroutine.

name: check_flag_and_return_pointer
description: Checks a global flag and calls a subroutine if it is set. It validates its argument against a table limit, looks up an entry in a global table and returns a pointer into the table if the entry is marked in use. Otherwise it records a fixed error code and returns null.

name: allocate_slot_and_open
description: Searches a global slot table for a free entry and fails if none is free. It marks the entry according to the requested access and creation flags, deletes the named file when asked, and opens it through the operating system. On failure it stores the system error and returns -1, otherwise the slot index.

name: open_file_at_slot_index
description: Rejects an index equal to the table limit, then sets the access and creation flags of the matching table entry. It deletes the named file when requested, opens it into the entry's handle field and returns the slot index, or -1 with the system error recorded on failure.

name: open_file_into_slot
description: Obtains a slot index from a subroutine, marks that table entry with access and creation flags, deletes the named file when requested and opens it into the entry's handle field. It returns the slot index, or -1 with the system error stored on failure.

name: open_file_in_preset_slot
description: Sets the entry's flag byte from the requested access bits, deletes the named file when requested and opens it into the entry's handle field. It returns the slot index on success, or -1 with the system error stored on failure.

name: open_file_mode_one_flagged
description: Sets the first access-mode bit in the entry's flag byte, with an extra bit when a request flag is set. It deletes the named file when requested and opens it into the entry's handle field, returning the slot index or -1 with the error recorded.

name: open_file_mode_one
description: Sets the first access-mode bit in the entry's flag byte, then deletes the named file when requested and opens it into the entry's handle field. It returns the slot index on success, or -1 with the system error recorded on failure.

name: open_file_mode_two_flagged
description: Sets the second access-mode bits in the entry's flag byte, with an extra bit when a request flag is set. It deletes the named file when requested and opens it into the entry's handle field, returning the slot index or -1 with the error recorded.

name: open_file_mode_two
description: Sets the second access-mode bits in the entry's flag byte, then deletes the named file when requested and opens it into the entry's handle field. It returns the slot index on success, or -1 with the system error recorded on failure.

name: fail_invalid_access_mode
description: Clears the entry's flag byte, stores a fixed error code and returns -1. It is the failure path taken when the requested access mode is not recognised.

name: open_file_for_entry
description: Optionally deletes the named file, chooses a creation mode from a flag bit and opens the file into the entry's handle field. On failure it records the system error and returns -1; otherwise it returns the stored slot index.

name: open_entry_with_fixed_mode
description: Opens the named file using a fixed creation mode and stores its handle in the entry. On failure it records the system error, clears the entry's flag byte and returns -1; otherwise it returns the slot index.

name: return_stored_slot_index
description: Returns the slot index held in a local variable, without any other work.

name: forward_open_with_access_flags
description: Forwards its arguments to another routine with a fixed set of access flags, keeping only the high flag bit from the caller's value. It returns nothing itself.

name: read_bytes_from_slot
description: Reads the requested number of bytes from the file handle of the given slot into the buffer. A negative count or a missing slot sets a fixed error code and returns -1, and a failed read records the system error.

name: read_bytes_from_open_entry
description: Reads a block of bytes from the file handle stored in the entry held in a local variable into the caller's buffer and returns the count read. A failed read records the system error and sets a fixed error code.

name: write_bytes_to_slot
description: Writes a block of bytes to the file handle of the given slot, repositioning the entry first when its flag bit is set. A negative count or a missing slot sets a fixed error code and returns -1; a failed write records the system error.

name: seek_slot_with_offset_table
description: Positions the file of the given slot at an offset taken from a global table indexed by the third argument, recording the system error on failure. It then makes a second seek call with zero arguments and returns that result. An invalid slot or index sets a fixed error code.

name: close_entry_unless_flagged
description: Returns a failure if the entry is missing, and does nothing if the entry's flag bit is set. Otherwise it closes the entry's file handle, clears the entry's flag byte and returns zero.

name: delete_named_file
description: Deletes the file named by the argument. It returns zero on success; on failure it records the system error and a fixed error code and returns -1.

name: return_constant_zero
description: Returns zero with no other work, so the caller receives a success or empty result.

name: open_default_file_handle
description: Opens the file whose name is held in a global variable using a fixed creation mode, and stores the returned handle in another global variable. It returns nothing.

name: read_byte_with_pushback
description: Returns a byte that was pushed back earlier if one is pending, clearing the pending value. Otherwise it reads one byte from the open file handle and returns it.

name: read_single_byte_from_file
description: Reads one byte from the open file handle into a local variable and returns it.

name: write_single_byte_to_file
description: Writes one byte to the open file handle and returns the same byte value. A flag check may run a preparatory routine first.

name: push_back_byte
description: Stores a byte in a pending-byte global so that the next read returns it. It returns an error value if a byte is already pending, otherwise the stored value.

name: store_argument_byte_global
description: Copies the low byte of the first argument into a global variable and returns nothing.

name: close_all_open_entries
description: Closes the file handle of every table entry that is in use and whose flag bit is clear, then passes its arguments to another routine.

name: open_intuition_and_show_request
description: Opens the intuition library and stores its base pointer in a global variable. It then shows an automatic requester with a text string and a fixed size, followed by a call to another routine with a fixed value.

name: process_player_movement_input
description: Reads a key code in a loop; for four direction codes it moves a wrapped grid position, and for other codes it dispatches to separate handlers. The pseudo-code is cut off, so this covers only the visible part of the routine.

name: step_actor_tick_movement
description: Runs a per-tick update that counts a timer down, then for direction codes moves a record's grid position within a limit of eleven. It branches on the record's type value to further handlers that adjust counters and related fields. The pseudo-code is cut off, so later branches are not described.

name: dispatch_input_code_movement
description: Handles an input byte by moving a grid position for direction codes, with a bounds check against eleven. Other codes branch to handlers for actions, counters and a decimal-adjusted value. The pseudo-code is cut off, so later branches are not described.

name: apply_grid_step_with_bounds
description: Applies a movement step to the grid position and rejects any position outside the eleven-by-eleven grid. An accepted step updates the record fields and table entries, and one special code clears two table entries to a fixed value.

name: dispatch_signed_action_code
description: Dispatches a signed action code: some codes run handlers directly, while others set a timer value, check a flag, or update a record's status fields using a decimal-adjusted counter.

name: update_record_status_fields
description: Writes status values from the record's fields into the record and a table entry, then updates a counter from a lookup result. It continues the action handler and branches on the outcome.

name: process_entity_turn_counter
description: Decrements a counter with decimal adjustment and moves an entity offset by its stored direction. It then branches on a lookup result to update the record fields.

name: resolve_record_tile_action
description: Stores a status byte into the record and checks a table value for a special case. It then updates the record's status fields from an offset-based result.

name: return_early_on_flagged_status
description: Checks a record flag bit and a status value. When the flag is set and the status exceeds a threshold, it calls one routine and returns, otherwise it returns without further work.

name: update_record_after_move
description: Updates a record's tile value and a counter, then scans a list of records for the matching position. Depending on the record's status it calls one of several routines and writes results back to the entity fields.

name: resolve_counter_depletion_message
description: Compares a stored counter with a record field and, when the counter is spent, places the record at its position and clears the counter. It refers to a text label reading a kill and experience message, and sets display fields before calling several routines.

name: dispatch_status_switch_table
description: Sets a status code and reads a table byte, looping until a value in a set range is found for certain entity types. It then adjusts a counter with decimal subtraction and dispatches on the status byte to separate handlers.

name: run_active_slot_turns
description: Iterates over eight slots in a table, skipping empty ones. For each occupied slot it runs turn handlers chosen by the record's status byte and updates the slot counters.

name: find_grid_position_index
description: Adds offsets to the current grid position within the eleven-by-eleven bound, then searches a table of stored positions for a match and records its index. With no match it calls a routine and writes the result back to the entity.

name: process_status_byte_branch
description: Calls several routines and checks a player-index condition and a limit against the record. It branches on a status byte with a set of fixed values and can loop back to the main loop.

name: dispatch_code_2e_check
description: Runs a handler when the input code is one specific value, then performs the same checks and routine calls as its neighbouring fragment. It branches back to the main loop when a limit is exceeded.

name: draw_player_label_update
description: Runs several routines, checks the player-index condition and a limit, then updates the record for a player label. It refers to a text label with a player prefix.

name: update_record_position_fields
description: Calls routines, stores a zero in a global variable, copies position values into the record and writes a code to the entity. The pseudo-code is cut off partway.

name: update_record_position_loop
description: Repeats a routine that reads a byte and updates the record's position fields, then runs the tail of the update. The pseudo-code is cut off.

name: select_packed_record_entry
description: Reads a packed word and masks it either to its low three bits or its low four bits, depending on a sign flag. It uses the masked index to pick a record entry and returns the masked value, clearing the entry when it is non-zero.

name: forward_to_four_routines
description: Makes four calls to other routines with no other logic of its own and then returns. A text label near it reads as a player prefix.

name: reset_record_code_if_matched
description: Reads a packed word and clears its low two bits. When those bits were zero and a record byte has one fixed value, it changes that byte to another fixed value, calls several routines and returns a new value.

name: advance_past_string_table_entries
description: Advances a global text pointer past a count of null-terminated strings, then calls one routine. It is used to skip to a numbered entry in a string table.

name: advance_past_string_table_entries
description: Advances a global text pointer past a count of null-terminated strings, then calls one routine. It is used to skip to a numbered entry in a string table.

name: advance_pointer_past_string_entries
description: Advances a text pointer held in a register past a count of null-terminated strings, then calls one routine. It is used to skip to a numbered entry in a string table.

name: handle_player_steal_action
description: Runs part of a player action with a text label reading as a steal action. It checks a status flag and a value range, and when they match it doubles a position offset before calling further routines. The pseudo-code is cut off.

name: double_offset_and_check_code
description: Checks a flag and a code range, and when they match it doubles two position offsets. For one specific code it sets a record byte and continues to the next routine.

name: handle_direct_move_action
description: Runs a movement check on a code within a fixed range and doubles two position offsets when it matches. A text label reads as a direct action, and the pseudo-code is cut off.

name: remap_marker_bytes_in_table
description: Scans a 64-entry global byte table and replaces each occurrence of one marker byte with another fixed value, then calls one routine.

name: check_code_in_range_offset
description: Reads a code and, if it lies in a fixed range, doubles two position offsets. When the code matches one specific value it sets a record byte.

name: branch_on_transaction_status
description: Checks a status byte and, when it is zero, calls three routines; otherwise it takes a second branch. A text label reads as a transaction message.

name: check_direct_action_label
description: Calls several routines, then compares a table byte with a fixed letter and branches on the result. A text label reads as a direct action.

name: check_special_position_match
description: Offsets two position values by a step when the code is within range. It calls a routine when the code is a specific value and the position matches fixed values, then branches to the next handler.

name: check_special_position_for_code
description: Offsets two position values by a step, then calls a routine. When the code is a specific value and the position matches fixed values, it runs a further handler.

name: test_special_position_flags
description: Compares a global flag and two position values with fixed numbers. When all match it calls one routine, otherwise it calls two others.

name: branch_on_zero_flag_chain
description: Calls routines and branches on a zero flag. When the flag is clear it runs a further check and sets a record field from a position value.

name: check_global_code_then_act
description: Checks a global code against a fixed value and, when it matches, runs a sequence of routines to act on the record.

name: check_global_code_for_action
description: Stores a position value in the record and checks a global code against a fixed value. When it matches it runs several routines to act on the record.

name: copy_record_state_to_global
description: Calls routines and copies a state byte from the record into a global variable. It then sets a record byte from a related value and returns through the surrounding fragment.

name: check_letter_entry_and_act
description: Compares a table byte with a fixed letter and, when it matches, calls routines to act on the record.

name: branch_on_entry_low_nibble
description: Tests the low four bits of a table entry and calls one routine when they are zero, otherwise another.

name: call_when_counter_zero
description: Calls routines and then, when a record counter is zero, calls one further routine.

name: set_global_eight_if_flag
description: Calls routines and sets a global variable to a fixed value when the zero flag condition holds. Otherwise it continues to the next fragment.

name: set_global_eight_and_update
description: Sets a global variable to a fixed value, calls routines and reads a record field for later comparison.

name: set_global_eight_and_compare
description: Sets a global variable to a fixed value and compares a record field with a second field, branching on the result.

name: increment_counter_if_code_low
description: For input codes below a threshold, or when a record flag is set, increments a record counter with decimal adjustment and clamps it to a fixed maximum.

name: increment_counter_capped_bcd
description: Increments a record counter with decimal adjustment and clamps it to a fixed maximum when it exceeds that maximum.

name: call_unless_mode_one
description: Calls routines and checks a mode field. When the mode is not one it calls a further routine.

name: call_when_mode_zero
description: Calls routines and, when a mode field is zero, calls a further routine.

name: check_key_item_unlock
description: Checks an item field and an input code, and when the code matches a fixed value it calls several routines. A text label reads as an unlock prompt asking whose key it is.

name: decrement_bcd_field_if_nonzero
description: Decrements a record field with decimal adjustment when it is non-zero, then calls one routine.

name: set_bcd_field_from_input
description: Sets a record field to the input value minus one, adjusted as a decimal, and copies a shifted value from another field into the record.

name: advance_audio_volume_step
description: Advances a four-step index and copies two table values into globals used for the volume of an audio channel.

name: show_item_wear_message
description: Sets a flag and clears a global, then calls routines. A text label reads as a wear message for an item.

name: select_armour_slot_entry
description: For codes up to four, decrements an index and calls routines. A text label reads as armour, and the pseudo-code is cut off.

name: find_occupied_slot_entry
description: Loops over a set of slot codes, offsets each by a fixed amount and checks the matching table entry. It stops at the first entry that is set.

name: store_selected_slot_index
description: Stores a selected slot value into the record's table entry and then calls a routine.

name: record_slot_index_and_call
description: Stores the slot index in the record and then calls a routine. The pseudo-code is cut off.

name: find_matching_code_in_table
description: Stores an input code in a record field, then searches an eleven-entry global table for the record's code and stops at the first match. It then calls one routine and compares the stored code with a fixed value.

name: branch_on_exit_key_code
description: Checks a record key byte against two fixed values and calls routines accordingly. A text label reads as an exit prompt.

name: run_exit_prompt_action
description: Runs routines and, unless a key byte equals a fixed value, calls another routine. A text label reads as an exit prompt, and the pseudo-code is cut off.

name: store_shifted_key_code
description: Stores a key code shifted left by one bit in a record field, sets a second field to a fixed value and continues with routine calls.

name: prompt_yell_target
description: Clears a record field, sets a flag and calls routines. A text label asks whom to yell at, and the pseudo-code is cut off.

name: call_on_mode_zero_entry
description: Calls routines and, when a mode field is zero, calls a further routine. It is an entry point into the same mode check as its neighbours.

name: adjust_glyph_when_flagged
description: When a record field has a fixed value and a status flag is set, it changes a second field from one fixed value to another and calls routines.

name: set_field_fixed_value_a
description: Sets a record field to a fixed value and then calls routines.

name: set_field_fixed_value_b
description: Sets a record field to a different fixed value and then calls routines.

name: run_routine_sequence_fragment
description: Calls several routines in sequence and returns.

name: mask_seven_bits_and_loop
description: Masks an input word to its low seven bits and stores it in a record field. It then loops calling routines while a record byte is non-zero.

name: draw_stats_label
description: Calls several routines and, depending on a zero flag, runs one more. A text label reads as a stats heading.

name: process_entries_until_done
description: Runs an outer loop that calls twelve routines to process entries until a condition ends it. The pseudo-code is cut off.

name: initialise_good_result_display
description: Sets a global flag to one and a global mask to a fixed value, stores two fixed bytes in the record and calls routines. A text label reads as a success message.

name: copy_triplet_records_to_fields
description: Walks a list of three-byte entries until a negative marker, copying two bytes from each into the record and calling routines for each entry.

name: initialise_skin_table_state
description: Sets a global pointer to a table, stores fixed sizes and values in globals and a record field, and walks the table. A text label reads as skin, and the pseudo-code is cut off.

name: initialise_hand_table_state
description: Sets a global pointer to a table, stores different fixed sizes and values in globals and a record field, and walks the table. A text label reads as hands, and the pseudo-code is cut off.

name: increment_record_counter_one
description: Calls two routines and then increments a record counter by one.

name: increment_record_counter_after_call
description: Calls one routine and then increments a record counter by one.

name: process_death_word_table
description: Copies a byte from the argument list into a record field, then walks a short table of word values. A text label reads as death, and the pseudo-code is cut off.

name: repeat_routine_count_times
description: Repeats two routine calls a number of times taken from a pointer argument and then returns.

name: count_string_bytes
description: Scans forward from a pointer argument byte by byte until it finds a zero byte. It returns the number of bytes examined before the terminator.

name: check_structure_flags_before_call
description: Returns an error when a status byte has one of two flag bits set. Otherwise it calls a routine on the structure when a link field is zero and a flag is clear, and returns an error if that call fails.

name: call_if_link_clear
description: Checks a structure's link field and a flag bit. When both allow it, it calls a routine on the structure and returns an error if that call fails.

name: mark_structure_busy_and_link
description: Returns an error if a structure's exclusive flag is set. Otherwise it sets the in-use flag bit, copies the link field into a local variable and continues with a routine call.

name: mark_inuse_and_call_routine
description: Returns an error if an exclusive flag is set, otherwise sets the in-use flag bit and calls a routine with the structure's fields.

name: set_flag_call_with_fields
description: Sets the in-use flag bit, copies the link field into a local variable and calls a routine with three values from the structure.

name: decrement_count_and_release
description: Decrements a counter field in a structure. When the result goes negative it calls a routine, otherwise it continues without further work.

name: forward_structure_to_routine
description: Passes the structure to another routine and returns.

name: write_byte_to_structure_buffer
description: Writes one byte into a structure's buffer and returns an error when a status flag blocks writing. It handles the case where a link field or flag bit is set and makes further calls to update the buffer state.

name: store_routine_result_in_fields
description: Returns zero when a link field is set and a flag bit is clear. Otherwise it calls a routine with a global pointer and stores the result in the structure and a duplicate field.

name: skip_sign_and_scan_chars
description: Skips a leading minus sign, then steps through characters whose class bit is set, calling a routine for each one. It is a text scanner used when parsing a number or word.

name: adjust_running_total_by_amount
description: Sets a flag and, when a second value is non-zero, raises a running total to at least a given amount and subtracts that amount. The pseudo-code is cut off.

name: adjust_running_total_entry
description: Sets a flag and, when a second value is non-zero, raises a running total to at least a given amount and subtracts that amount. This is an alternate entry into the same logic.

name: adjust_running_total_tail
description: Continues the running-total adjustment: when a second value is non-zero it raises the total to a floor and subtracts an amount. The pseudo-code is cut off.

name: fill_buffer_with_repeated_byte
description: Writes a fixed byte value into a buffer for a count held in a local variable, then stores the advanced pointer back. It fills a run of identical bytes.

name: fill_buffer_padding_then_digits
description: Writes a fixed byte into a buffer for one count, then runs a second loop for another count. The pseudo-code is cut off before the second loop finishes.

name: copy_string_bytes_to_buffer
description: Copies a count of bytes from a source pointer into a buffer, advancing both pointers as it goes.

name: store_value_and_return_increment
description: Stores a local value through a pointer argument and returns an argument value increased by one.

name: default_width_to_six
description: Substitutes a default width of six when the width is minus one, and uses the width as given when it is below twenty.

name: format_value_with_width
description: Stores a width value, calls a routine that formats a value with a width and a flag, then advances a pointer and stores the result.

name: decrement_digit_count_when_set
description: Sets a flag and decrements a digit count when it is non-zero. It clears a local variable and checks another count afterwards.

name: compute_absolute_digit_count
description: Adds an offset to a running count and takes the absolute value of a signed count for use in the padding calculation.

name: count_decimal_digits
description: Counts how many digits a value has beyond one, by comparing it with the thresholds ninety-nine and nine hundred ninety-nine, and adds to a digit count.

name: write_number_with_sign
description: Writes a minus sign into the output buffer when a sign flag is set, then writes the digits of the value. The pseudo-code is cut off.

name: pad_output_with_zeros
description: Writes zero characters into the output buffer for each remaining digit position until the counter goes negative, then writes the digits.

name: write_zero_padded_digits
description: Writes zero characters into the output buffer, then loops over the remaining digit count. The pseudo-code is cut off before the loop ends.

name: emit_digits_until_count_done
description: Loops over a digit count, writing a zero character whenever the counter goes negative. It stops when the count is exhausted.

name: write_zeros_then_digit_loop
description: Writes a zero character and then loops over a digit count to emit the remaining digits. The pseudo-code is cut off.

name: write_decimal_point_and_digits
description: Writes a decimal point when a count is non-zero, then loops to write the digits that follow it.

name: write_zero_then_fraction_digits
description: Writes a zero character, then loops over a count to emit the fractional digits.

name: pad_integer_digits_with_zeros
description: Decrements a digit counter and writes a zero character when the counter goes negative, then writes the digit that follows.

name: write_zero_point_and_digits
description: Writes a zero character and a decimal point, then loops over a count to emit the digits after the point.

name: write_zero_then_digit_run
description: Writes a zero character and then a run of digits from a count held in a local variable. The pseudo-code is cut off.

name: write_exponent_and_sign
description: Writes an exponent marker character, then a minus sign when the exponent is negative. The pseudo-code is cut off.

name: write_plus_sign_and_digits
description: Writes a plus sign and then a fixed-length run of digits from a count. The pseudo-code is cut off.

name: emit_remaining_fraction_digits
description: Subtracts a count from a running value when a flag and a comparison allow it, then loops to write the remaining fractional digits.

name: copy_value_and_increment_counter
description: Copies a local value into a structure field through a pointer and returns an argument value increased by one.

name: handle_attack_prompt_action
description: Sets a status code and calls routines. A text label reads as an attack prompt, and the pseudo-code is cut off.

name: run_routine_fragment_calls
description: Calls several routines in sequence as the start of a further fragment. The pseudo-code is cut off.

name: copy_table_value_to_record
description: Reads a value from a global table at an index and stores it in a record field, then calls routines.

name: check_board_menu_code
description: Checks a record field against a fixed value and branches when a code matches a fixed character. A text label reads as a board prompt.

name: set_code_four_on_match
description: Compares a code with a fixed character and, when it matches, sets a record byte to four.

name: set_record_state_fourteen
description: Sets a record byte to four and two state fields to a fixed value of fourteen.

name: set_record_state_sixteen
description: Clears a record byte and sets two state fields to a fixed value of sixteen.

name: prompt_cast_by_whom
description: Sets a status byte and a flag and tests a value for zero, calling routines. A text label asks who cast a spell, and the pseudo-code is cut off.

name: run_two_routine_calls
description: Calls two routines in sequence and returns.

name: copy_and_test_zero_flag
description: Copies a status byte into a second field, tests the original for zero and calls two routines.

name: handle_spell_menu_selection
description: Checks a record class code against fixed values and calls routines to show spell menu text for cleric or wizard spellcasting, including a spell type prompt. The pseudo-code is cut off.

name: call_and_return_first_result
description: Calls routines, then returns the value produced by the first call.

name: check_status_pair_and_branch
description: Checks three record fields against fixed values and branches to the next handler when any of them differs. The pseudo-code is cut off.

name: set_direct_flag_bits
description: Sets one flag bit on a record field from a routine result. A text label reads as a direct action, and the pseudo-code is cut off.

name: set_timer_ten_and_call
description: Sets a record counter to ten and then calls routines.

name: increment_index_up_to_seven
description: When a status value is one, calls a routine and increments a record index, stopping at a maximum of seven.

name: increment_record_index
description: Increments a record index field and then loops over the following routine calls. The pseudo-code is cut off.

name: check_index_nonzero_branch
description: When a status value is one and the record index is non-zero it branches, otherwise it calls routines.

name: set_action_field_fixed
description: Sets a record action field to a fixed value and checks a status byte against a second fixed value.

name: check_status_and_slot_limit
description: Calls routines and branches on a status byte and a record field, which must not equal a fixed value.

name: store_doubled_code_field
description: Calls routines and stores a code doubled in value into a record field.

name: set_long_timer_and_call
description: Sets a record counter to a fixed value of 250 and then calls routines.

name: call_two_routines_then_loop
description: Calls two routines and then starts a loop. The pseudo-code is cut off.

name: set_action_field_default_value
description: Sets a record action field to a fixed value and checks a status byte against a second fixed value.

name: scan_flagged_table_entries
description: Loops over a value returned by a call, and when its low two bits are set and a global table entry is non-zero, it calls a routine.

name: set_action_field_maximum
description: Sets a record action field to the largest byte value, then checks a status byte against a fixed value.

name: set_wait_counter_twenty
description: Sets a record wait counter to twenty and then calls routines.

name: store_doubled_result_field
description: Calls routines and stores a result doubled in value into a record field.

name: set_status_eight_and_call
description: Checks a status byte against a fixed value and, when it matches, calls a routine and sets a record field to eight.

name: set_nonzero_table_entries_five
description: Walks a global table from an index and sets each non-zero entry to five, calling a routine as it goes. The pseudo-code is cut off.

name: copy_table_pair_to_record
description: Copies a value from a global table at an index into two record fields, stores a fixed byte in the entity and calls routines.

name: set_action_field_maximum_alt
description: Sets a record action field to the largest byte value and then checks a status byte. This is an alternate entry into the same handler.

name: check_three_fields_for_action
description: Checks three record fields against fixed values and branches to the next handler when any of them differs.

name: copy_result_into_action_field
description: Calls routines and copies the returned byte into a record action field.

name: prompt_heal_target
description: Calls routines and branches on the zero flag. A text label asks whom to heal, and the pseudo-code is cut off.

name: branch_when_status_one
description: Calls a routine and branches when a status byte is one, otherwise it takes the other path.

name: prompt_cure_target
description: Calls routines and branches on the zero flag. A text label asks whom to cure, and the pseudo-code is cut off.

name: call_when_low_bits_set
description: Calls a routine and tests the low two bits of the returned byte, branching when they are clear.

name: call_when_status_one
description: When a status byte is one, calls a routine. The pseudo-code is cut off before the other path is shown.

name: store_result_in_action_field
description: Calls routines and stores the returned byte in a record action field.

name: branch_unless_status_one
description: Calls a routine and branches unless a status byte is one.

name: set_global_ten_and_call
description: Calls a routine, then sets a global variable to ten.

name: check_status_flag_then_act
description: Checks a status byte against a fixed value and, when it does not match, calls routines. Otherwise it runs a different sequence of routines.

name: set_record_code_and_call
description: Sets a record code byte to a fixed value of 199, then calls a routine.

name: prompt_recall_target
description: Checks a status byte and calls routines. A text label asks whom to recall, and the pseudo-code is cut off.

name: call_three_record_routines
description: Calls two routines in sequence and then a third on the record. The pseudo-code is cut off.
